zero_check_policy.existing_parser: _SUBPROGRAM accepts only flowanalyzed AND proved(Nchecks) rows, N may0; flow-only rows are rejected. parse_summary also reconciles every listed row with unit analyzed count. Manifest validation accepts nonnegative checks; do not silently require positive counts for every trivial helper.
zero_check_policy.must_preserve: Do not accept bare flow rows, notproved rows, missing or source-mismatched rows, synthetic report edits, cached partial summaries as final proof, or numeric target subsets as full coverage.
zero_check_policy.legitimate_zero: Pure modular/total expression helpers such as Digest.Nibble may have no generated runtime-check VC and can legitimately have0checks. A zero-check row proves no substantive theorem by itself. Retain actual verification scope/call graph/meaningful contracts rather than add vacuous assertions to inflate counts.
zero_check_policy.nontrivial_claims: Initialize_Input,Decode_Into,projects and numeric bridges have meaningful Post/termination/assertion obligations. Require fresh actual discharge of these original properties and every introduced private premise. A prior flow-only or selected0check row cannot substitute for their proof.
zero_check_policy.invocation_boundary: prove.sh original full-U --modeall strict command with successful exit, fresh summary, exact source/build/lib identities and perunit analyzed==available remains mandatory. Imported SPARKlib source requires separate original driver; -U does not erase that boundary.
